articles.title: Trump sending US military hospital ship to Greenland to 'take care' of sick
articles.summary: Following past U.S. interest in acquiring Greenland, a recent medical evacuation by Denmark's Joint Arctic Command led to the U.S. dispatching significant medical assistance. This development underscores Greenland's strategic importance in the Arctic, highlighting international cooperation and humanitarian aid. It also suggests evolving U.S.-Denmark relations amidst ongoing geopolitical considerations for the vast Arctic territory.

articles.title: Indian Air Force dazzles Jaipur with air show
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force (IAF) recently conducted a spectacular air show over Jaipur's Jal Mahal, featuring thrilling displays by the 'Surya Kiran Aerobatic Team' and 'Sarang Helicopter Display Team'. This event showcased the IAF's exceptional precision flying skills and advanced capabilities, engaging the public and highlighting the professionalism of its personnel. Such demonstrations are vital for fostering national pride and inspiring youth towards a career in the armed forces.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia-Greece fiber optic project to pass through Syria instead of occupied territories: Report
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia aims to establish a fiber-optic cable connecting the kingdom to Europe, with a preference for Syria as the transit route. This strategic decision highlights a move towards enhancing digital connectivity while deliberately avoiding 'occupied territories' for its pathway. This initiative underscores significant regional infrastructure development and the ongoing geopolitical considerations influencing Middle Eastern diplomacy and connectivity projects.

articles.title: GOA MARITIME CONCLAVE 2026 REINFORCES SHARED VISION OF MARITIME SECURITY IN INDIAN OCEAN REGION
articles.summary: The 5th Edition of the Goa Maritime Conclave (GMC-26), organized by the Ministry of Defence, successfully concluded at the Naval War College in Goa. This significant event likely focused on enhancing maritime security, fostering regional cooperation, and discussing strategic challenges in the Indian Ocean region. Its successful conduct underscores India's commitment to maritime diplomacy and safeguarding its naval interests.

articles.title: AUKUS enters new era with the arrival of UK submarine into Western Australia
articles.summary: HMS Anson, a UK submarine, has arrived at HMAS Stirling in Western Australia for its inaugural maintenance activity. This significant event, announced by Australia's Deputy Prime Minister and Defence Minister Richard Marles, marks a crucial milestone in multinational defence cooperation, likely under the AUKUS pact. It underscores deepening strategic partnerships and interoperability for regional security.

articles.title: Tejas, Rafale, Sukhoi-30MKI, Jaguar and more take part in IAF’s Exercise Vayushakti-26, see photo
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force will conduct Exercise Vayushakti-26 at Pokhran on February 27, 2026. This large-scale drill aims to demonstrate the IAF's advanced operational prowess, including its ability to execute long-range strikes and integrated multi-domain operations. Such exercises are crucial for SSB aspirants to understand India's military readiness and technological advancements in air power, highlighting strategic capabilities.

articles.title: Defence forces move towards unified battlefield, ISR & cyber data: DG DRDO
articles.summary: The DRDO is crucial for India's national defence, driving innovation to significantly enhance the capabilities and capacity of the armed forces. It develops advanced applications by exploring and contextualising new technologies, modernizing military equipment and strategies. This continuous R&D ensures self-reliance and prepares Indian forces to effectively meet evolving security challenges with cutting-edge solutions.

articles.title: Afghanistan's ruling Taliban say Pakistan strikes kill, injure dozens
articles.summary: Pakistan launched retaliatory strikes against militant targets in Afghanistan, blaming them for recent suicide bombings, including deadly assaults during Ramadan. This action highlights escalating cross-border security tensions and Pakistan's resolve to counter terrorism emanating from Afghan soil. Such incidents underscore regional instability and the complex challenges impacting Afghanistan-Pakistan bilateral relations.
